title: One application-filing core behind the apply, quick, lead and CV doors (completion: apply, quick and lead doors migrated)
tests_added: app/_lib/application-filing.test.ts (+6 cases, source guard widened to all four doors)
deviations_from_card: One code commit (implementation + re-pointed tests + the locked rate-limit-contract marker) rather than test-then-feat: the new cases pin core inputs (proof 'token', tokenEntry, raced, safeStatusToken) that do not typecheck before the core exists, and the contract marker must move in the same commit as the route to keep every commit green; the lock was held across that commit. The core grew five door hooks instead of per-door code: `stub` (profile-less lead filing), `onEntry` (lead token mint before consent/ack), `statusLinkFor`/`enrichLinkFor(entry, kind)` (links minted synchronously before deferral), `defer(task, kind)` (keeps the apply-ack / apply-reack labels) and `repeatDetail` (keeps the conversational door's prose re_applied detail with its change list, so no new catalog keys were needed). A raced filing at proof 'none' now writes like 'channel' (consent + re_applied); this is what the conversational route already did on its race, and the first builder's core had silently dropped it. The conversational name now goes through sanitizeFreeText (the core's name hygiene); ordinary names are unchanged. The lead door's repeat pushes 'contact email captured' only when the merge returned a row; before, it pushed it even on a vanished row, which is not reachable in practice.
notes: Re-pointed source-contract tests (each pins the new expression AND forbids the old defect; the commit body lists what each now pins): apply-ack-after-response, apply-intake-scope, apply-error-hygiene, quick-apply-status-link, gap-followup-candidate, and rate-limit-contract (the apply route's `expensive` marker is now `fileApplication(`; key, limit and window are unchanged, and the limiter still precedes it). Copies counted by the source guard: entry-stage rule 3 -> 1, consent block 4 -> 1 (the core's recordConsentSafely), status-link mint 2 -> 1 (the core's exported safeStatusToken). Card-B behaviour is preserved: reapply-capability-gate.test.ts passes unchanged (5/5), and the unproven branch answers `!filed.merged` with recoverApplicationLinks and a tokenless acknowledgement. The new route test is a behaviour pin that was green before and after (token proof in a non-default workspace: contact, handle, consent, the prose re_applied detail and the deferred re-ack with ?lang= all land in W). Gates: tsc exits 1 only on the untracked, foreign kpi-sim/ run tree; eslint, api:check, docs:check and lint:ts-ratchet are 0. test:perf is red only on the two known lines (llm-config 322/320, job-ingest 403/400); the quick route's graph grew through lead-intake -> application-filing but stays inside its ceiling. Full test:unit: 9500/9501. The one BROKEN is app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts 'an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree'. It also fails standalone, imports none of the touched modules, and its sources were last changed in 2e4883486/bbb2f56c6, so it is environmental (a Windows process-tree kill) and not this change. The result JSON itself is not committed (the coordinator records builds).
